key_insight: VITAL selectively verbalizes informative reasoning tokens while keeping most computation latent, improving mathematical reasoning without lengthy explicit chains.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive switching between token generation and hidden-state feedback offers a route to more compact mathematical reasoning while preserving precision-critical steps.
method: Estimate token importance in explicit chains of thought to construct hybrid reasoning trajectories.
Use a lightweight gating head to choose explicit token generation or direct hidden-state feedback.
Apply curriculum-based supervised training, then reinforcement learning balancing correctness and conciseness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports relative average accuracy gains over fully latent methods of 9.6% on GPT-2 and 5.1% on Llama-3.2-1B at comparable reasoning lengths, plus higher accuracy with shorter trajectories than hybrid baselines on Qwen3-1.7B.
watch_item: Shorter reasoning trajectories do not establish lower end-to-end latency; the abstract provides no wall-clock measurements.
paper_title: Learning When to Think Aloud in Latent Reasoning
